neighbours.label: the copula or verb that opens the definition in an encyclopedic sentence ('Igneous rocks are one of ...', 'A party wall is a ...')
fire: Sedimentary rocks are one of the three main rock types.
A load-bearing wall is a wall that supports the roof.
Basalt is a dark volcanic rock rich in iron.
Feldspars are the most common minerals in the crust.
A watershed is an area of land that drains into one river.
Marble was the material of choice for Greek sculptors.
Horsehair bristles were the only option for early brushes.
Metamorphic rocks are rocks changed by heat and pressure.
quiet: Sedimentary rocks lined the bottom of the canyon.
A load-bearing wall cracked during the storm.
Basalt covered the road after the eruption.
Feldspars glittered in the afternoon sun.
A watershed meeting was held in the town hall.
Marble dust covered the floor of the workshop.
Horsehair bristles fell out of the old brush.
Metamorphic rocks were collected on the field trip.

notes: Probes: 'Igneous rocks are' 0.68, 'party wall is' 0.52, but simpler definitions read 0.1-0.3.
